item.title: Utah inmate faces new charges for taking sexually explicit images of minor victim
item.description: A prison inmate serving time for a sex offense against a child is facing new charges for sexually explicit images he took of the victim.

item.title: Man caught in avalanche on Saturday dies from injuries
item.description: The 57-year-old victim of an avalanche last Saturday has died from his injuries.

item.title: 'Horrified': Park City mother speaks out, alleges caregiver mistreated newborn
item.description: A Park City mother is speaking out after a hired caretaker was allegedly aggressive with her newborn.

item.title: Utah and other states reach $100 million settlement with Walmart
item.description: Utah is one of several states that reached a multimillion-dollar settlement with Walmart this week over deceptive practices with its Spark Driver Program.

item.title: Neurogenesis and 'super agers': What can you do to reduce your risk of Alzheimer's and dementia?
item.description: After new research into so called "super agers," neurogenesis, and Alzheimer's was published in a major journal, ABC4 spoke to one of the researchers to understand what it might mean for you.

item.title: Idaho State Police investigating fatal motorcycle crash in Oneida County
item.description: One person is dead following a motorcycle crash just north of Malad City.

item.title: 'Generationally meaningful': Officials announce Jordan River revitalization project
item.description: Today, officials with Salt Lake City, the Larry H. Miller company, and other organizations announced a community-driven initiative to restore parts of the Jordan River.

item.title: 'If he would have just stopped, would my son be alive today?': Family of hit and run victim speak on legislation for harsher penalties
item.description: The family of a 13-year-old boy who was killed in a hit and run by a drunk driver in 2022 is speaking out in support of a bill that is currently making its way through Utah legislature.

item.title: Judge addresses juror safety issue in Kouri Richins Trial
item.description: A disturbance occurred in the courtroom today during Kouri Richins' trial, leading to some concerns about juror safety.

item.title: Redistricting, abortion plaintiffs ask Utah Supreme Court to halt Utah legislature's new three-judge panel
item.description: It's been a dizzying week of court filings after Utah's attorney general gave notice to four cases before lower-court judges that they wanted to move those cases to newly created three-judge panels, with three of the four cases asking lower court judges to block the new law. Now, two of those plaintiffs have asked the Utah Supreme Court to step in quickly.
